newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian premier to visit Switzerland Oct 1-2.
newsitem.headline: Russian premier to visit Switzerland Oct 1-2.

text.p: Russian Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin will start a two-day working visit to Switzerland on Tuesday during which he plans to meet President Jean-Pascal Delamuraz and Foreign Minister Flavio Cotti.
A Russian government spokesman said on Monday that the meeting with Cotti, who is also chairman of the Organisation for Security and Cooperation in Europe (OSCE), would take place on Tuesday evening.
The two men were expected to discuss preparations for an OSCE summit in Lisbon in December, the agency said.
Chernomyrdin is also likely to visit the headquarters of the International Olympic Committee in Lausanne.
Russian President Boris Yeltsin is in hospital preparing for heart surgery and Chernomyrdin has assumed some of his powers.
An IOC spokeswoman said last week that Chernomyrdin, constitutional stand-in for Yeltsin, would be meeting the organisation's president Juan-Antonio Samaranch.
Diplomats said the agenda for their discussions was likely to include the bid by St Petersburg, Russia's second city, to host the 2004 Olympic Games.
Chernomyrdin chairs the committee of support for the city's Olympic bid. Moscow staged the 1980 Olympic Games.
